dialogue.text: The Pyde Piper of Hamlin shout out to all lovers of very dark tales.
dialogue.zh: 哈姆林的吹笛者，向所有喜愛黑暗故事的人致敬。
dialogue.ja: ハムリンの笛吹き男は、暗い物語を愛するすべての人に呼びかけます。
dialogue.local: The Pyde Piper of Hamlin shout out to all lovers of very dark tales.
dialogue.local_pron: The Pyde Piper of Hamlin shout out to all lovers of very dark tales.
dialogue.en: The Pyde Piper of Hamlin shout out to all lovers of very dark tales.
dialogue.en_pron: The Pyde Piper of Hamlin shout out to all lovers of very dark tales.

dialogue.ja: 笛吹き男が子供たちを連れて行きました！

dialogue.text: The town of Hamlin had a problem.
dialogue.zh: 哈姆林鎮遇到了一個問題。
dialogue.ja: ハムリンの町には問題がありました。
dialogue.local: The town of Hamlin had a problem.
dialogue.local_pron: The town of Hamlin had a problem.
dialogue.en: The town of Hamlin had a problem.
dialogue.en_pron: The town of Hamlin had a problem.

dialogue.text: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 老鼠無處不在，我是說無處不在。
dialogue.ja: ネズミはどこにでもいて、本当にどこにでもいました。
dialogue.local: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.
dialogue.local_pron: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.
dialogue.en: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.
dialogue.en_pron: The rats were everywhere and I mean everywhere.

dialogue.ja: 私たちは飢えています！

dialogue.text: My youngest is sick because of them.
dialogue.zh: 我最小的孩子因為牠們生病了。
dialogue.ja: 私の末っ子は彼らのせいで病気です。
dialogue.local: My youngest is sick because of them.
dialogue.local_pron: My youngest is sick because of them.
dialogue.en: My youngest is sick because of them.
dialogue.en_pron: My youngest is sick because of them.

dialogue.text: People of Hamlin, I know you're suffering.
dialogue.zh: 哈姆林的人民，我知道你們正在受苦。
dialogue.ja: ハムリンの人々、あなたたちが苦しんでいるのはわかっています。
dialogue.local: People of Hamlin, I know you're suffering.
dialogue.local_pron: People of Hamlin, I know you're suffering.
dialogue.en: People of Hamlin, I know you're suffering.
dialogue.en_pron: People of Hamlin, I know you're suffering.

dialogue.text: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.
dialogue.zh: 議會日夜努力解決這場危機。
dialogue.ja: 議会はこの危機を解決するために昼夜働いています。
dialogue.local: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.
dialogue.local_pron: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.
dialogue.en: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.
dialogue.en_pron: The council is working day and night to solve this crisis.

dialogue.text: Working, the rats ate half my bakery yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 努力？老鼠昨天吃掉我一半的麵包店。
dialogue.ja: 努力している？ネズミは昨日私のパン屋の半分を食べました。
dialogue.local: Working, the rats ate half my bakery yesterday.
dialogue.local_pron: Working, the rats ate half my bakery yesterday.
dialogue.en: Working, the rats ate half my bakery yesterday.
dialogue.en_pron: Working, the rats ate half my bakery yesterday.

dialogue.zh: 他們毀壞了我的穀物庫存！
dialogue.ja: 彼らは私の穀物倉庫を破壊しました！

dialogue.text: What are we supposed to eat this winter?
dialogue.zh: 這個冬天我們該吃什麼？
dialogue.ja: この冬、私たちは何を食べるべきですか？
dialogue.local: What are we supposed to eat this winter?
dialogue.local_pron: What are we supposed to eat this winter?
dialogue.en: What are we supposed to eat this winter?
dialogue.en_pron: What are we supposed to eat this winter?

dialogue.ja: 私たちは努力しています...
努力だけでは足りません！

dialogue.text: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
dialogue.zh: 如果繼續這樣，哈姆林將無法存活！
dialogue.ja: このままだと、ハムリンは生き残れません！
dialogue.local: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
dialogue.local_pron: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
dialogue.en: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!
dialogue.en_pron: If this continues, Hamlin won't survive!

dialogue.text: I can rid the town of all rats.
dialogue.zh: 我可以讓鎮上所有老鼠消失。
dialogue.ja: 私は町のすべてのネズミを取り除くことができます。
dialogue.local: I can rid the town of all rats.
dialogue.local_pron: I can rid the town of all rats.
dialogue.en: I can rid the town of all rats.
dialogue.en_pron: I can rid the town of all rats.

dialogue.text: And perhaps the solution to your problem.
dialogue.zh: 也許是你們問題的解決方法。
dialogue.ja: そしておそらくあなたの問題の解決策です。
dialogue.local: And perhaps the solution to your problem.
dialogue.local_pron: And perhaps the solution to your problem.
dialogue.en: And perhaps the solution to your problem.
dialogue.en_pron: And perhaps the solution to your problem.

dialogue.text: You claim you can stop the rats?
dialogue.ja: ネズミを止められると主張しますか？
dialogue.local: You claim you can stop the rats?
dialogue.local_pron: You claim you can stop the rats?
dialogue.en: You claim you can stop the rats?
dialogue.en_pron: You claim you can stop the rats?

dialogue.ja: 止めるのではありません。

dialogue.text: I can remove them every single one.
dialogue.zh: 我可以把牠們一隻不留地趕走。
dialogue.ja: 私はすべてのネズミを取り除くことができます。
dialogue.local: I can remove them every single one.
dialogue.local_pron: I can remove them every single one.
dialogue.en: I can remove them every single one.
dialogue.en_pron: I can remove them every single one.

dialogue.text: And what payment do you ask?
dialogue.ja: 報酬は何を求めますか？
dialogue.local: And what payment do you ask?
dialogue.local_pron: And what payment do you ask?
dialogue.en: And what payment do you ask?
dialogue.en_pron: And what payment do you ask?

dialogue.ja: 私が失敗した場合のみです。

dialogue.text: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.
dialogue.zh: 如果還有老鼠剩下，你們不欠我任何東西。
dialogue.ja: もしネズミが残っていれば、あなたは私に何も支払う必要はありません。
dialogue.local: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.
dialogue.local_pron: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.
dialogue.en: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.
dialogue.en_pron: If any rat remains, you owe me nothing.

dialogue.text: And if you succeed, then you will honor your word.
dialogue.zh: 如果成功了，你們就要遵守承諾。
dialogue.ja: そして成功したら、あなたは約束を守るでしょう。
dialogue.local: And if you succeed, then you will honor your word.
dialogue.local_pron: And if you succeed, then you will honor your word.
dialogue.en: And if you succeed, then you will honor your word.
dialogue.en_pron: And if you succeed, then you will honor your word.

dialogue.text: People of Hamlin, if this man truly frees us from the rats,
dialogue.zh: 哈姆林的人民，如果這個人真的解救我們脫離老鼠，
dialogue.ja: ハムリンの人々、この男が本当に私たちをネズミから解放してくれたら、
dialogue.local: People of Hamlin, if this man truly frees us from the rats,
dialogue.local_pron: People of Hamlin, if this man truly frees us from the rats,
dialogue.en: People of Hamlin, if this man truly frees us from the rats,
dialogue.en_pron: People of Hamlin, if this man truly frees us from the rats,

dialogue.text: will you contribute to his payment?
dialogue.zh: 你們願意支付他的報酬嗎？
dialogue.ja: 彼の報酬に協力しますか？
dialogue.local: will you contribute to his payment?
dialogue.local_pron: will you contribute to his payment?
dialogue.en: will you contribute to his payment?
dialogue.en_pron: will you contribute to his payment?

dialogue.ja: 私は自分の分を出します。
私が持っているすべてのコインです。
私たちは何でも払います。
あなたには私たちの約束があります。

dialogue.zh: 那麼我們的交易成立了。
dialogue.ja: それでは私たちの取引は成立です。
なんと、効果が出ています！
彼は本当にやり遂げました。

dialogue.text: With the rats gone, Hanlon prospered one small.
dialogue.zh: 老鼠消失後，哈姆林小鎮繁榮起來。
dialogue.ja: ネズミがいなくなり、ハンロンは小さく繁栄しました。
dialogue.local: With the rats gone, Hanlon prospered one small.
dialogue.local_pron: With the rats gone, Hanlon prospered one small.
dialogue.en: With the rats gone, Hanlon prospered one small.
dialogue.en_pron: With the rats gone, Hanlon prospered one small.

dialogue.ja: おはようございます、パイパー様。

dialogue.text: The rats are gone, that they are.
dialogue.ja: ネズミはもういません、その通りです。
dialogue.local: The rats are gone, that they are.
dialogue.local_pron: The rats are gone, that they are.
dialogue.en: The rats are gone, that they are.
dialogue.en_pron: The rats are gone, that they are.

dialogue.text: Then I have come to collect the payment we agreed upon.
dialogue.zh: 那我來收取我們約定的報酬。
dialogue.ja: それでは、私たちが合意した支払いを受け取りに来ました。
dialogue.local: Then I have come to collect the payment we agreed upon.
dialogue.local_pron: Then I have come to collect the payment we agreed upon.
dialogue.en: Then I have come to collect the payment we agreed upon.
dialogue.en_pron: Then I have come to collect the payment we agreed upon.

dialogue.text: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.
dialogue.zh: 一千枚金幣是荒謬的數量。
dialogue.ja: 1000枚の金貨はばかげた額です。
dialogue.local: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.
dialogue.local_pron: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.
dialogue.en: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.
dialogue.en_pron: 1,000 gold coins is an absurd amount.

dialogue.ja: 今になってばかげていると言うのですか。

dialogue.text: You played a tune and took a walk.
dialogue.zh: 你吹了首曲子然後散步。
dialogue.ja: あなたは曲を演奏して散歩しただけです。
dialogue.local: You played a tune and took a walk.
dialogue.local_pron: You played a tune and took a walk.
dialogue.en: You played a tune and took a walk.
dialogue.en_pron: You played a tune and took a walk.

dialogue.text: I would say 50 is more than generous.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得五十已經很慷慨了。
dialogue.ja: 50は十分に寛大だと思います。
dialogue.local: I would say 50 is more than generous.
dialogue.local_pron: I would say 50 is more than generous.
dialogue.en: I would say 50 is more than generous.
dialogue.en_pron: I would say 50 is more than generous.

dialogue.ja: あなたは約束しました。

dialogue.text: We gave our word under desperate circumstances.
dialogue.zh: 我們是在絕望的情況下給的承諾。
dialogue.ja: 私たちは絶望的な状況で約束しました。
dialogue.local: We gave our word under desperate circumstances.
dialogue.local_pron: We gave our word under desperate circumstances.
dialogue.en: We gave our word under desperate circumstances.
dialogue.en_pron: We gave our word under desperate circumstances.

dialogue.text: That does not mean we must be foolish.
dialogue.zh: 那不代表我們必須愚蠢。
dialogue.ja: それは私たちが愚かでなければならないという意味ではありません。
dialogue.local: That does not mean we must be foolish.
dialogue.local_pron: That does not mean we must be foolish.
dialogue.en: That does not mean we must be foolish.
dialogue.en_pron: That does not mean we must be foolish.

dialogue.text: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.
dialogue.zh: 承諾只有在付出代價時才有價值。
dialogue.ja: 約束は守るために何かを犠牲にするときにのみ価値があります。
dialogue.local: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.
dialogue.local_pron: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.
dialogue.en: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.
dialogue.en_pron: A promise has value only when it costs something to keep.

dialogue.text: Take the 50 gold coins or take nothing.
dialogue.zh: 拿走五十枚金幣或什麼都不要。
dialogue.ja: 50枚の金貨を受け取るか、何も受け取らないかです。
dialogue.local: Take the 50 gold coins or take nothing.
dialogue.local_pron: Take the 50 gold coins or take nothing.
dialogue.en: Take the 50 gold coins or take nothing.
dialogue.en_pron: Take the 50 gold coins or take nothing.

dialogue.ja: 金貨は取っておきなさい。

dialogue.text: But know this, you owe me a debt, so I will return.
dialogue.zh: 但你們要知道，你們欠我一筆債，所以我會回來。
dialogue.ja: しかし、これを知っておいてください。あなたは私に借りがあるので、私は戻ってきます。
dialogue.local: But know this, you owe me a debt, so I will return.
dialogue.local_pron: But know this, you owe me a debt, so I will return.
dialogue.en: But know this, you owe me a debt, so I will return.
dialogue.en_pron: But know this, you owe me a debt, so I will return.

dialogue.text: And when I do, I will collect what is owed to me.
dialogue.zh: 當我回來時，我會收回我應得的。
dialogue.ja: そして戻ったとき、私は私に借りがあるものを回収します。
dialogue.local: And when I do, I will collect what is owed to me.
dialogue.local_pron: And when I do, I will collect what is owed to me.
dialogue.en: And when I do, I will collect what is owed to me.
dialogue.en_pron: And when I do, I will collect what is owed to me.

dialogue.ja: 彼を行かせてください。

dialogue.text: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hanlon from exploitation and the entire town agrees with our decision.
dialogue.zh: 我們有責任保護哈姆林的市民免受剝削，整個鎮都同意我們的決定。
dialogue.ja: 私たちはハンロンの市民を搾取から守る義務があり、町全体が
dialogue.local: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hanlon from exploitation and the entire town agrees with our decision.
dialogue.local_pron: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hanlon from exploitation and the entire town agrees with our decision.
dialogue.en: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hanlon from exploitation and the entire town agrees with our decision.
dialogue.en_pron: We have a duty to protect the citizens of Hanlon from exploitation and the entire town agrees with our decision.

dialogue.ja: 今日は繁栄を祝います。

dialogue.text: Emily, go play with your friends.
dialogue.zh: 艾蜜莉，去和你的朋友玩吧。
dialogue.ja: エミリー、友達と遊びに行きなさい。
dialogue.local: Emily, go play with your friends.
dialogue.local_pron: Emily, go play with your friends.
dialogue.en: Emily, go play with your friends.
dialogue.en_pron: Emily, go play with your friends.

dialogue.text: There now, little one, you'll feel better soon.
dialogue.zh: 好了，小寶貝，你很快會好起來的。
dialogue.ja: さあ、小さな子、すぐに良くなりますよ。
dialogue.local: There now, little one, you'll feel better soon.
dialogue.local_pron: There now, little one, you'll feel better soon.
dialogue.en: There now, little one, you'll feel better soon.
dialogue.en_pron: There now, little one, you'll feel better soon.

dialogue.ja: トーマス、どこに行くの？
どこにも行かせません。

dialogue.text: Thomas, what is wrong with you?
dialogue.local: Thomas, what is wrong with you?
dialogue.local_pron: Thomas, what is wrong with you?
dialogue.en: Thomas, what is wrong with you?
dialogue.en_pron: Thomas, what is wrong with you?

dialogue.ja: トーマス、よしよし、小さな子。
すぐに良くなりますよ。

dialogue.text: Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, please.
dialogue.zh: 托馬斯，托馬斯，托馬斯，托馬斯，托馬斯，托馬斯，拜託。
dialogue.ja: トーマス、トーマス、トーマス、トーマス、トーマス、トーマス、お願い。
dialogue.local: Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, please.
dialogue.local_pron: Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, please.
dialogue.en: Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, please.
dialogue.en_pron: Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, Thomas, please.

dialogue.ja: ハンロンへ、ハンロンへ。
祭りを止めてください。
奥様、何が起こったのですか？

dialogue.text: The Piper, he's back and he has all our children.
dialogue.zh: 吹笛者回來了，他帶走了我們所有的孩子。
dialogue.ja: パイパーが戻ってきて、私たちの子供たちを連れて行きました。
dialogue.local: The Piper, he's back and he has all our children.
dialogue.local_pron: The Piper, he's back and he has all our children.
dialogue.en: The Piper, he's back and he has all our children.
dialogue.en_pron: The Piper, he's back and he has all our children.

dialogue.ja: 彼は子供たちを連れて行っています。
彼らは彼について行っています。
みんなの子供たちです。

dialogue.zh: 這是他們消失的地方嗎？
dialogue.ja: ここで彼らは消えたのですか？
彼らは戻ってきますか？

dialogue.text: But they left us something important.
dialogue.zh: 但他們留給我們一些重要的東西。
dialogue.ja: しかし、彼らは私たちに重要なものを残しました。
dialogue.local: But they left us something important.
dialogue.local_pron: But they left us something important.
dialogue.en: But they left us something important.
dialogue.en_pron: But they left us something important.

dialogue.text: Gold lost can be earned again.
dialogue.zh: 失去的金子可以再賺回來。
dialogue.ja: 失われた金は再び稼ぐことができます。
dialogue.local: Gold lost can be earned again.
dialogue.local_pron: Gold lost can be earned again.
dialogue.en: Gold lost can be earned again.
dialogue.en_pron: Gold lost can be earned again.

dialogue.text: A harvest lost can grow again.
dialogue.zh: 失去的收成可以再長出來。
dialogue.ja: 失われた収穫は再び育つことができます。
dialogue.local: A harvest lost can grow again.
dialogue.local_pron: A harvest lost can grow again.
dialogue.en: A harvest lost can grow again.
dialogue.en_pron: A harvest lost can grow again.

dialogue.ja: しかし、信頼は一度壊れると、

dialogue.text: may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
dialogue.zh: 可能會付出比任何人願意承擔的更多代價。
dialogue.ja: 誰もが払いたくないほどの代償を伴うかもしれません。
dialogue.local: may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
dialogue.local_pron: may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
dialogue.en: may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
dialogue.en_pron: may cost far more than anyone is willing to pay.
